segments.text:
V. 44.
He was a murderer—In Inclination, from the beginning— Of his becoming a Devil; and abode not in the truth—Commencing Murderer and a Liar at the ſame Time. And certainly He was a killer of men (as the Greek Word properly ſignifies) from the beginning of the World: For from the very Creation he deſigned and contrived the Ruin of Men. When be ſpeaketh a lie, be ſpeaketh of his own—For he is the proper Parent, and as it were, Creator of it. See the Origin not only of Lies, but of Evil in general!
